text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Slovak government approved a draft of a framework for next year's state budget, according to which the country's gross domestic product (GDP) should grow by at least five percent and inflation should total six percent.

PRACA - The board of the National Bank of Slovakia approved a report on monetary developments for the first quarter of 1997. The board said it had managed to cut credit activities in the commercial banks. It also allowed the biggest Slovak commercial bank VUB to provide mortgage loans.
- The public transport drivers strike in Bratislava is politically motivated, the paper says, as Bratislava's mayor is a member of the opposition Christian Democratic Movement (KDH).

PRAVDA - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar appointed the relatively unknown Zdenka Kramplova to the post of Foreign Minister just to maintain his own dominant position in the running of foreign policy, former premier Jozef Moravcik said.
- The head of the official state radio Jan Tuzinsky, who has also been a parliamentarian for the ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS), resigned from his post.
SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - The National Bank of Slovakia decided to check the forex positions of commercial banks on a daily basis, after running checks every ten days previously.
